commitResults.messageTitle: Developer Guide: Generalize use case steps
commitResults.messageBody: The use cases describe user goals, but several steps expose CLI command names and command-format terminology.\n\nRewrite those steps and error flows in terms of user intent and observable application behavior so the use cases remain independent of the interface implementation.

commitResults.messageBody: The use case flows include unnecessary system prompts and extension branches that contradict their preconditions.\n\nSimplify the add-client flow to capture the user's request and input directly, and remove redundant missing-client extensions from the add-pet and add-appointment use cases. Add pn/, ty/, and nt/ definitions so the parser can tokenize note

Add NoteCommand to update, replace, and clear one note type while
preserving the rest of the client record. Reject invalid clients,
unknown pets, and missing notes without mutating the model.

The note command accepts a displayed client, pet name, note type,
and an optional note value.

Parse and validate these fields while treating omitted or blank note
values as a request to clear the selected note type. Reject malformed
commands before command execution.

PawPalsParser does not dispatch note commands yet, so valid note
input cannot reach the command implementation.

Register NoteCommandParser under the note command word so note input
uses the same command dispatch path as the existing commands.

Note command parsing must reject malformed input before execution
can modify client data.

invalid values, duplicate prefixes, and malformed commands.

Pet note execution must update only the selected pet and note
type while preserving existing notes and client data.

Add coverage for setting, replacing, clearing, and preserving notes,
as well as missing pets, missing notes, invalid clients, and null
arguments.

The top-level parser must route note commands to the dedicated
parser so valid user input reaches note execution.

Add an integration assertion for parsing a complete note command.
